metrics.name: p0_assertion_failures
metrics.source: contract_results c JOIN assertion_definitions a ON c.assertion_id = a.assertion_id

metrics.name: schema_contract.outcome.pass_rate
metrics.source: contract_results c JOIN assertion_definitions a ON c.assertion_id = a.assertion_id

metrics.name: cost.usd_per_run.p95
metrics.aggregation: WITH model_cost AS (SELECT s.run_id, SUM(mc.cost_usd) AS usd FROM model_call_spans mc JOIN spans s ON s.span_id = mc.span_id GROUP BY s.run_id), embedding_cost AS (SELECT s.run_id, SUM(es.cost_usd) AS usd FROM embedding_spans es JOIN spans s ON s.span_id = es.span_id GROUP BY s.run_id), per_run AS (SELECT rr.run_id, COALESCE(model_cost.usd,0) + COALESCE(embedding_cost.usd,0) AS run_cost FROM run_results rr LEFT JOIN model_cost ON model_cost.run_id = rr.run_id LEFT JOIN embedding_cost ON embedding_cost.run_id = rr.run_id) SELECT percentile_disc(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY run_cost) FROM per_run
metrics.notes: Pre-aggregated per-run CTEs prevent row multiplication when joining multiple one-to-many typed span tables. Tool and retrieval costs are not summed here because tool_call_spans and retrieval_spans do not carry a cost_usd column in v1; add those columns + a tool_cost / retrieval_cost CTE before the next major version if customers want them included.

baselines.name: previous_release_sha
baselines.lookup: JOIN runs r ON rr.run_id = r.run_id; previous run_results where r.release_sha = COALESCE(:release_sha_prev, ANY)

baselines.name: rolling_p50_7d
baselines.lookup: median over runs in trailing 7 days excluding flagged-flaky
